ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 70-75% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels occupy approximately 25-30% concentrated centrally and along leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) region extending from the peduncle base in a broad 'Y' shape toward the median notch. Thick low-intensity bands along the leading edges of both lobes. High-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the vast majority of the left and right lobe fields. Small, low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are visible on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-depth of 15% of the total fluke height and an internal angle of roughly 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel height) interspersed with smoother linear segments. Minor irregular jaggedness visible on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Maintains a primarily linear to slightly convex sweep from the base toward the tips, with the tips exhibiting sharp, pointed geometric termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark 'X' shaped linear intersection located in the upper mid-region of the right lobe. A secondary horizontal linear mark is visible on the lower-mid right lobe. Several thin, unaligned dark lines present on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular indentation (notch) near the distal tip of the right lobe suggesting minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'X' or 'cross' pigmentation pattern on the right lobe.
